messages.author: Kshatresh Dutta Dubey
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
I will be thankful if someone could suggest to fix the issue during
installation of Amber 22. I am installing Amber 22 on an RHEL 8,
cuda-enable ( cuda version 11.04 and gcc 11.3). I have applied all Amber
tool updates, however I am getting following error:
/data/home/kshatresh.dubey/PROGRAMS/amber22_src/AmberTools/src/sander/mdfil.F90:157:13:
rismcrdfil    = ''
1
Error: Symbol ‘rismcrdfil’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type; did you mean
‘crdfile’?
/data/home/kshatresh.dubey/PROGRAMS/amber22_src/AmberTools/src/sander/mdfil.F90:159:16:
rismcrdrstfil = ''
1
Error: Symbol ‘rismcrdrstfil’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type
/data/home/kshatresh.dubey/PROGRAMS/amber22_src/AmberTools/src/sander/mdfil.F90:158:13:
rismfrcfil    = ''
1
Error: Symbol ‘rismfrcfil’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type; did you mean
‘rism3d_fft’?
/data/home/kshatresh.dubey/PROGRAMS/amber22_src/AmberTools/src/sander/mdfil.F90:160:16:
rismfrcrstfil = ''
1
Error: Symbol ‘rismfrcrstfil’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type
make[2]: ***
[AmberTools/src/sander/CMakeFiles/sander_base_obj.dir/build.make:1831:
AmberTools/src/sander/CMakeFiles/sander_base_obj.dir/mdfil.F90.o] Error 1
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:4264:
AmberTools/src/sander/CMakeFiles/sander_base_obj.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [Makefile:156: all] Error 2
Best regards
Kshatresh

messages.author: Kshatresh Dutta Dubey
messages.body:
Thanks a lot David. It worked.
Best regards
Kshatresh
On Mon, Jan 16, 2023 at 11:48 PM David A Case <david.case.rutgers.
edu>
wrote:
> On Sat, Jan 14, 2023, Kshatresh Dutta Dubey via AMBER wrote:
> >
> >I will be thankful if someone could suggest to fix the issue during
> >installation of Amber 22. I am installing Amber 22 on an RHEL 8,
> >cuda-enable ( cuda version 11.04 and gcc 11.3). I have applied all Amber
> >tool updates, however I am getting following error:
> >
>
> >/data/home/kshatresh.dubey/PROGRAMS/amber22_src/AmberTools/src/sander/mdfil.F90:157:13:
> >
> >    rismcrdfil    = ''
> >             1
> >Error: Symbol ‘rismcrdfil’ at (1) has no IMPLICIT type; did you mean
> >‘crdfile’?
>
> This is indeed a very odd error.  The code looks perfectly fine, and no one
> else has ever reported this problem.
>
> Is there a chance that you are compiling a second time, and that some old
> files might be lying around?  If so, use the "clean_build" script in
> amber22_src/build to get rid of all previous attempts.  It might be worth
> re-installing everything into a fresh directory and starting over.
>
> I don't have anything better to suggest right now.
>
> ....dac
>
>
--
